description: Prepare a BUG REPORT for the user: it opens in Frapea (Problems → Create bug report) for them to read and save. The report itself is NOT returned to you — it would leave the user's machine before they have seen it. You get a summary: open problems, media counts, and how many of the user's own words remain in composition code. It contains versions, problems with engine details, the project's structure with names and texts replaced, provider files by public id, the user's own files only as encoding fingerprints, and motion code. timelineIds limits it to those timelines and what they nest.

projectId.description: Project id from get_projects (must be open in the editor).

timelineIds.description: Only these timelines and the timelines they nest (default: all).

token.description: The session token `connect` returned. Pass it on every call — it says which browser to drive.

name: get_bug_report
title: Prepare bug report
